prompt:

report:
## Answer
The late-delivery rate remained almost the same, but the average delivery time increased, suggesting potential issues with logistics or order fulfillment. The decrease in orders and cancellation rate may indicate a shift in customer behavior or operational changes.

## Findings
- Late-delivery rate: 2.99% (May) vs. 3.03% (June) (+0.04%).
- Average delivery time: 11.4 days (May) vs. 12.0 days (June) (+0.6 days).
- Average promised delivery window: 24.9 days (May) vs. 24.7 days (June) (-0.2 days).
- Orders: 3700 (May) vs. 3245 (June) (-455).
- Cancellation rate: 1.62% (May) vs. 1.23% (June) (-0.39%).

## Investigate first
- Check if there was a change in the distribution of orders across regions or product categories that could have affected delivery times.
- Analyze the performance of sellers with the highest late-delivery rates in June to identify any patterns or common issues.
- Review the reasons for the decrease in orders and how it might have impacted the overall delivery performance.

## Limitations
- The dashboard does not provide granular data on specific regions, product categories, or seller performance.
- There is no information on the reasons for cancellations or the nature of overdue undelivered orders.
